stem: A child with constipation and non-bilious vomiting is found to have swallowed multiple magnets. What is the most appropriate management?

options.text: Give laxatives and review as an outpatient
Urgent specialist operative or endoscopic removal

explanation: Multiple swallowed magnets can attract across bowel walls and cause obstruction, perforation or fistula. Symptomatic ingestion requires urgent specialist management rather than outpatient observation alone.
